WITH stock_at_period_end AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsw.closing_units) AS total_closing_units,
    SUM(fsw.closing_value) AS total_closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_in_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) AS receipt_count
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  s.category,
  sc.total_closing_units,
  sp.total_units_sold,
  ROUND(CAST(sp.total_units_sold AS DECIMAL) / 4, 2) AS avg_weekly_units,
  ROUND(CAST(sc.total_closing_units AS DECIMAL) / (CAST(sp.total_units_sold AS DECIMAL) / 4), 2) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM sales_in_period sp
LEFT JOIN stock_at_period_end sc ON sp.category = sc.category
ORDER BY s.category

WITH all_categories AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current = TRUE AND category != 'ZZ Test'
),
stock_at_period_end AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsw.closing_units) AS total_closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fsw
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsw.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_in_period AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) AS total_units_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  ac.category,
  COALESCE(sc.total_closing_units, 0) AS closing_units,
  COALESCE(sp.total_units_sold, 0) AS units_sold
FROM all_categories ac
LEFT JOIN stock_at_period_end sc ON ac.category = sc.category
LEFT JOIN sales_in_period sp ON ac.category = sp.category
ORDER BY ac.category
